### A Tragic End for Judas
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/tragic-end-judas
Passage: Matthew 27:3-4
Points:
- Judas felt profound remorse over Jesus' condemnation, yet his regret lacked genuine, godly repentance.
- Unlike Peter who wept and was restored, Judas chose despair and took his own life rather than turning back to God.
- The chief priests showed gross hypocrisy by fussing over ceremonial blood money laws while actively plotting the death of an innocent man.
- The purchase of the potter’s field fulfilled prophetic warnings concerning Israel's rejection of God’s appointed shepherd.
- Christ freely offers pardon to all who seek His grace instead of giving in to despair.
